issue_request: Published/Persuasive technical correction for FHIR-core Medication, raised in R4 and applied for R5, reporting that the medication-form-codes ValueSet could not be expanded because the publication tooling did not know SNOMED CT concept 736542009.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-25441. additional_context: FHIR-19296 established 736542009 as the intended medication form parent, and git history changed medication-form-codes from 421967003 to 736542009. Zulip terminology discussion before the seed identified 736542009 as the correct replacement for retired/ambiguous 421967003 and treated remaining expansion failures as terminology server/cache/tooling state.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Medication is active in the build, Medication.doseForm binds to medication-form-codes, source/medication/valueset-medication-form-codes.xml includes SNOMED CT concept is-a 736542009, and the local SNOMED tooling data recognizes 736542009 as Pharmaceutical dose form.
